name: 全球数字资产现货交易平台
description: 全球第三大Spot CEX，2025年增长最快的主流CEX之一，全年Spot Volume YoY增长+90.9%，达到$1.5T。已做到全球第三大Spot CEX（9.1%市占率）。总部位于新加坡，服务全球170+个国家和地区，拥有超过4000万用户。
descriptionEn: The world's third-largest Spot CEX, one of the fastest-growing mainstream CEXs in 2025, with Spot Volume YoY growth of +90.9% to $1.5T. Ranking third globally in Spot CEX (9.1% market share). Headquartered in Singapore, serving 170+ countries and regions with over 40 million users.

name: 具身智能训练数据平台
description: 高速成长的种子轮具身智能初创公司，致力于构建下一代机器人智能基础设施。End-to-End Data Solutions For Embodied AI，做数据为主，针对机器人/具身智能行业，数据是从真实生活中获取手部数据、人体数据，给大模型使用。在北京、苏州和Santa Clara都有Office，目前全职员工超过100人。
descriptionEn: A fast-growing seed-stage embodied AI startup committed to building the next generation of robotics intelligent infrastructure. End-to-End Data Solutions For Embodied AI, focusing on data solutions for robotics/embodied AI industry. Data is collected from real-life scenarios including hand data and human body data for LLM training. Offices in Beijing, Suzhou, and Santa Clara, with over 100 full-time employees.
stage: 种子轮

name: AI旅行+本地生活APP
description: AI旅行+本地生活双场景平台

name: AI 可穿戴珠宝公司
description: 一家兼具审美与洞察力的 AI 可穿戴珠宝公司，打造真正适合全天佩戴的 AI 设备。成立约 3 个月即获 Best of CES 2026 及「最佳 CES 创业公司」奖项。产品覆盖智能耳环、项链等形态，聚焦日记记录、自我认知辅助与情感陪伴等生活场景。Pre-seed 轮由美国 South Park Commons（SPC）领投，已投资 40 万美元并承诺后续跟投 60 万美元，总计约 100 万美元。
descriptionEn: An AI wearable-jewelry company combining refined design with meaningful personal insight, building devices intended for comfortable all-day use. Around three months after founding, it received Best of CES 2026 and a Best CES Startup award. Its smart earrings, necklaces, and related products support journaling, self-awareness, and emotional companionship. Its pre-seed round was led by South Park Commons, with US$400K invested and a further US$600K committed, totaling approximately US$1M.
stage: Pre-seed

name: Personal AGI
description: 打造属于每个人的Personal AGI
descriptionEn: Building Personal AGI for Everyone
stage: A轮

name: 北美 AI 购物助手
description: 面向北美市场的 AI Agent 消费助手，AI 替用户全网比价、自动下单
descriptionEn: AI shopping agent for North American market - scours the web, finds best deals, and executes purchases automatically
stage: 早期创业

name: 纯仿真训练机器人基础模型平台
description: 成立于 2024 年，是全球增长较快的具身智能独角兽之一，估值超过 20 亿美元，投资方包括阿里巴巴、腾讯、宁德时代旗下投资机构及 IDG 资本等。公司于 2026 年 4 月发布软硬件全栈自研机器人系统，核心为基于纯仿真训练、聚焦物体抓取的操作基础模型。无需真实世界数据、人类演示或逐物体微调，即可对未见物体实现高可靠抓取，并在 60 分钟连续测试中取得接近 100% 的成功率。
descriptionEn: Founded in 2024, this is one of the world's faster-growing embodied-AI unicorns, valued above US$2 billion and backed by investors including Alibaba, Tencent, an investment affiliate of CATL, and IDG Capital. In April 2026, the company introduced a vertically integrated robotics system centered on a manipulation foundation model trained entirely in simulation. Without real-world training data, human demonstrations, or per-object fine-tuning, it can reliably grasp unseen objects and achieved a near-100% success rate in a continuous 60-minute evaluation.
stage: 独角兽

name: 全球内容社区平台
description: 成熟的全球化内容社区平台，已建立覆盖多元垂类的活跃创作者生态，并持续拓展国际市场。团队致力于通过社区、内容与产品能力，帮助全球创作者建立影响力并实现长期成长。
descriptionEn: An established global content community platform with an active creator ecosystem spanning diverse verticals and a growing international presence. The team helps creators build influence and achieve long-term growth through community, content, and product capabilities.
stage: 成熟全球化平台

name: 全球 AI 创意设计 Agent 平台
nameEn: Global AI Creative Design Agent Platform
description: 全球领先的 AI 原生创意科技公司，核心产品以设计 Agent 重构从品牌视觉、营销素材到完整创意工作流的生产方式。公司产品生态已服务超过 3,000 万用户，累计融资近 3 亿美元，估值超过 20 亿美元，拥有成熟的多模态 AI 技术、全球化产品能力和快速扩张的国际市场团队。
descriptionEn: A leading AI-native creative technology company redefining how branding, visual design, marketing assets, and end-to-end creative workflows are produced through design agents. Its product ecosystem serves more than 30 million users. With nearly US$300 million in funding and a valuation exceeding US$2 billion, the company combines mature multimodal AI capabilities with strong global product execution and a rapidly expanding international team.
stage: 独角兽
location: 上海 / 旧金山 / 纽约 / 东京 / 首尔
locationEn: Shanghai / San Francisco / New York / Tokyo / Seoul

name: 女性 AI 疗愈科技品牌
description: 以女性主义为核心理念的灵性疗愈科技品牌，以神女能量珠宝、智能软硬件和 AI 疗愈产品为载体，结合荣格心理学与古希腊女神原型叙事，为职场女性提供有尊严、有文化深度的心理支持。品牌正在建设全球女性互助社群 Queendom.S，连接女性主义者、身心疗愈者与女性社区，并将部分收入捐赠给全球女性公益组织。
descriptionEn: A feminist spiritual-wellness technology brand combining goddess-inspired jewelry, intelligent hardware, software, and AI-guided healing experiences. Grounded in Jungian psychology and Greek goddess archetypes, it provides culturally thoughtful, dignified emotional support for women. Its global mutual-support community, Queendom.S, connects feminists, wellness practitioners, and women's communities, while a portion of brand revenue supports women's nonprofit organizations worldwide.
stage: Pre-A轮

name: AI 原生推荐与商业化基础设施
description: 成立于 2026 年的全球化 AI Native 公司，已获得硅谷风险投资机构等数百万美元天使轮投资。创始团队兼具顶尖多模态算法研究与连续创业经验，曾参与 MSRA 多模态大模型研究，并主导过百万用户级 AI 产品从 0 到 1 的研发与商业化。公司切入广告投放与卖家增长场景，通过 Agent 打通 Insight、Creative 与 Data 闭环，构建面向全球市场的 AI 原生商业增长基础设施，在北京和美国均设有主体。
descriptionEn: Founded in 2026, this global AI-native company is backed by several million US dollars in angel funding from Silicon Valley venture investors and other institutions. Its founding team combines frontier multimodal AI research with repeatedly validated 0-to-1 entrepreneurship, including foundation-model research and building AI products that reached more than one million users. The company serves advertising and seller-growth workflows, using agents to connect Insight, Creative, and Data into an end-to-end commercial growth loop, with entities in Beijing and the United States.
stage: 数百万美元天使轮

name: AI 原生广告商业化网络
description: 硅谷 AI 创业公司，创始团队来自 Google Ads、Meta Ads 与 Meta Superintelligence Labs，致力于构建 AI 时代的新一代广告商业化基础设施。团队规模不足 10 人，已融资约 600 万美元；供给侧已连接头部出海短剧产品，覆盖超过 1,000 万 DAU，预算侧已连接头部休闲游戏及电商平台，可触达广告预算超过 1 亿美元，并获得多位广告科技行业资深创业者与投资人的支持。
descriptionEn: A Silicon Valley AI startup founded by veterans of Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Meta Superintelligence Labs, building next-generation monetization infrastructure for AI-native content and entertainment. The team has fewer than 10 people and has raised approximately US$6 million. On the supply side, it works with leading global short-drama products reaching more than 10 million DAU; on the demand side, it connects with top casual-game and e-commerce advertisers with access to over US$100 million in budget, backed by experienced advertising technology founders and investors.
stage: 早期融资约 600 万美元

name: 全球 AI 达人营销平台
description: 全球领先的 AI 原生达人营销双边平台，汇聚超过 5 万名认证科技创作者，并服务快速成长的 AI、消费电子、电商与游戏品牌。团队分布北美与亚洲，核心成员来自全球领先科技企业和连续创业团队，在欧美市场与中国品牌出海市场均拥有专业 GTM 能力，致力于以 AI 建设更高效、智能、透明的达人营销基础设施。
descriptionEn: A leading AI-native two-sided creator marketing platform connecting more than 50,000 verified technology creators with fast-growing AI, consumer electronics, e-commerce, and gaming brands. Its North America and Asia-based team combines global technology and repeat-founder experience, building more efficient, intelligent, and transparent infrastructure for creator marketing.
stage: 高速增长期
location: 北京总部 / 北美 / 中国多地
locationEn: Beijing HQ / North America / Multiple China Locations

name: 隐私优先 AI 对话平台
description: 早期隐私优先 AI 对话产品，通过统一界面连接 Claude、GPT、Gemini 与开放权重模型。与依赖服务条款承诺的常见方案不同，其基础设施只基于元数据完成路由，不接触用户输入内容，将隐私保护建立在产品架构本身。团队致力于为工作沟通、法律与医疗问题及敏感创意场景提供兼具主流产品体验与强隐私保障的 AI 工具。
descriptionEn: An early-stage, privacy-first AI chat product that provides access to Claude, GPT, Gemini, and open-weight models through one interface. Its infrastructure routes on metadata without seeing prompt contents, grounding the privacy guarantee in architecture rather than policy promises. The team is building a mainstream-quality experience for sensitive work conversations, legal and medical questions, and private ideas.
stage: 早期创业
location: 全球远程（优先亚太，也考虑美国）

name: 全球主动式 AI 生活平台
description: 一家面向欧美与东南亚等全球市场的 ToC AI 创业公司，正在打造以生活方式为核心的主动式 AI 助手。产品通过长期理解用户的日常习惯、兴趣偏好与生活场景，主动提供本地生活建议，并逐步协助完成预约、订购和行程安排等任务，让 AI Agent 不只回答问题，也能真正参与用户的日常生活。
descriptionEn: A consumer AI startup serving global markets across North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia. The team is building a proactive lifestyle assistant that learns users' routines, interests, and preferences over time, recommends relevant local experiences, and helps complete tasks such as reservations, ordering, and planning. The goal is to make an AI agent that participates meaningfully in everyday life rather than merely answering questions.
stage: 早期全球化产品

name: 全球 Physical AI 数据与仿真平台
nameEn: Global Physical AI Data & Simulation Platform
description: 全球领先的 Physical AI 数据与仿真基础设施公司，围绕 3D 仿真数据、仿真遥操作与自动驾驶合成数据三大方向，提供从数据采集、策略训练、仿真评测到 Sim2Real 部署的全流程解决方案。公司已完成多轮大额融资，年营收突破亿元，并与全球头部芯片、大模型、机器人、汽车及工业企业建立合作，规模化交付与商业化能力已得到市场验证。
descriptionEn: A leading Physical AI data and simulation infrastructure company spanning three core areas: 3D simulation data, simulation-based teleoperation, and synthetic data for autonomous driving. It provides end-to-end solutions from data collection and policy training to simulation evaluation and Sim2Real deployment. The company has completed multiple major funding rounds, surpassed RMB 100 million in annual revenue, and works with leading global chip, foundation-model, robotics, automotive, and industrial companies, demonstrating validated commercial and large-scale delivery capabilities.
stage: 多轮大额融资

name: 全球在线旅行与酒店预订平台
description: 全球领先的一站式在线旅行服务平台，以技术连接旅行者与全球酒店、交通、目的地及其他旅行服务。平台拥有成熟的国际化产品体系、多语言与多币种服务能力，并持续通过搜索、内容、数据和本地化运营提升全球用户的旅行预订体验。
descriptionEn: A leading global one-stop online travel platform connecting travelers with hotels, transportation, destinations, and other travel services through technology. The platform operates a mature international product ecosystem with multilingual and multi-currency capabilities, continuously improving global travel discovery and booking through search, content, data, and localization.
stage: 全球上市互联网平台

name: 工业移动操作机器人平台
description: 专注于工业场景通用移动操作机器人的 Physical AI 公司，核心团队来自全球头部工业机器人企业与 UC Berkeley 机器人研究体系，曾将 AI 码垛、抓取等能力从研发推进至商业化。团队累计拥有 25 项机器人专利、6 项 IEEE 最佳论文或提名奖及 100 余篇顶级会议论文。其旗舰机器人融合 AMR 移动底座、力感知协作机械臂、真空末端执行器与 AI 感知及运动规划系统，面向卡车卸货、移动码垛、机器上下料等非结构化工业任务；自研工业物理智能操作系统支持实时感知、自主决策、现场适应与持续学习。产品已进入真实客户现场，并连续获得北美头部物流自动化展会创新奖及全球机器人创新奖。
descriptionEn: A Physical AI company building general-purpose mobile manipulators for industrial environments. Its core team combines experience from a global industrial-robotics leader with UC Berkeley robotics research and has taken AI palletizing and picking systems from research to commercialization. Collectively, the team holds 25 robotics patents, six IEEE best-paper or finalist honors, and more than 100 publications in leading venues. Its flagship robot integrates an AMR base, a force-sensing collaborative arm, a vacuum end effector, and AI perception and motion planning for unstructured tasks such as trailer unloading, mobile palletizing, and machine tending. A proprietary industrial physical-intelligence operating layer enables perception, autonomous decisions, real-time adaptation, and continuous learning. The system is deployed at real customer sites and has earned consecutive innovation awards at major North American logistics-automation shows as well as a global robotics innovation award.
stage: Seed · 累计融资约 1,770 万美元

name: 头部互联网智能输入产品团队
nameEn: Leading Internet Intelligent Input Product Team
description: 来自头部互联网公司的国民级输入产品团队，服务大规模 C 端用户，拥有成熟的产品、算法与工程协作体系。团队正在围绕大语言模型、Agent、多模态交互、语音识别与合成等前沿能力，探索 AI 在文字输入、智能表达、语音交互与内容创作等高频场景中的产品化落地，为用户提供更自然、高效且个性化的表达体验。
descriptionEn: A national-scale intelligent input product team within a leading internet company, serving a large consumer user base with mature product, algorithm, and engineering capabilities. The team is exploring product applications of large language models, agents, multimodal interaction, speech recognition, and speech synthesis across high-frequency scenarios including text input, intelligent expression, voice interaction, and content creation.
stage: 头部互联网 · 成熟业务

name: C 端 AI 创意表达平台
description: 成立于 2025 年的明星 AI 创业团队，专注面向大众用户的多模态创意表达产品，通过 AI 降低漫画、图像与叙事内容的创作门槛，让普通用户也能完成高质量 UGC 创作。首款产品已验证自然流量与用户需求，更多 AI Native 产品正在保密孵化。创始团队拥有头部互联网 C 端 AI 产品从 0 到 1 的成功经验，核心成员多数来自一线科技公司，技术负责人兼具顶尖院校、大厂与创业经历。公司已获得头部 VC 与大型互联网战略投资方的千万美元级天使轮融资，资金可支持未来 2–3 年有序扩张及自研模型训练；团队规模约 100 人，在同轮次 AI 应用创业公司中处于领先位置。
descriptionEn: A high-profile AI startup founded in 2025 and focused on multimodal creative-expression products for consumers. Its products lower the barrier to creating comics, images, and narrative content, enabling everyday users to produce high-quality UGC. The first product has validated organic acquisition and user demand, with additional AI-native products in confidential incubation. The founding team has proven zero-to-one experience in consumer AI at a leading internet company, while the broader team combines top-university, big-tech, and startup backgrounds. The company has raised a US$10M-level angel round from a leading VC and a major internet strategic investor, providing 2–3 years of runway for disciplined expansion and in-house model development. The team is approximately 100 people and ranks among the strongest companies at its stage.
stage: 千万美元级天使轮 · 约 100 人

name: 全球 AI 手写与知识生产力平台
nameEn: Global AI Handwriting & Knowledge Productivity Platform
description: 总部位于伦敦的科技独角兽，旗下数字笔记与知识生产力产品拥有数千万全球用户，曾位列全球 iPad 付费应用年度下载榜首，商业化与营收增长表现稳健。公司正在上海组建中国区创始团队，围绕无限画布、数字手写、记录、学习与协作场景打造 AI Native 解决方案。团队成员主要来自一线互联网公司，决策链条短，提供先进模型与充足 AI 工具资源；依托成熟品牌、全球渠道及健康现金流，可在无融资压力下持续投入长期产品建设。
descriptionEn: A London-headquartered technology unicorn whose digital note-taking and knowledge-productivity products serve tens of millions of users worldwide and have ranked first among paid iPad apps by annual global downloads. The profitable, high-growth company is building a founding China team in Shanghai to develop AI-native solutions for infinite-canvas, handwriting, learning, note-taking, and collaboration scenarios. The team combines talent from leading internet companies, short decision paths, access to frontier models and generous AI tooling, a globally established brand, strong distribution, and the financial stability to invest for the long term without fundraising pressure.
stage: 伦敦科技独角兽 · 稳健高增长
stageEn: London Technology Unicorn · Profitable High Growth

name: 全球 Top 10 数字资产平台
description: 全球头部数字资产与金融基础设施平台，服务超过 8,000 万用户，业务覆盖 180 多个国家和地区。平台围绕数字资产交易、支付、财富管理、托管、机构服务与 Web3 基础设施构建完整生态，并持续探索 Crypto、TradFi 与 AI 的融合。公司在欧洲、中东等主要市场持续推进合规布局，拥有全球化、多语言、全天候服务能力。团队由来自金融、科技、区块链与 AI 领域的国际化人才组成，强调用户优先、高效执行、持续创新和全球协作，为复杂金融系统提供大规模、高可用的技术与产品能力。
descriptionEn: A global top-10 digital asset and financial infrastructure platform serving more than 80 million users across over 180 countries and regions. Its ecosystem spans digital-asset trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 infrastructure, with continued investment at the intersection of crypto, traditional finance, and AI. The company is advancing regulated operations across major European and Middle Eastern markets and provides global, multilingual, around-the-clock services. Its international team brings together talent from finance, technology, blockchain, and AI, with a culture centered on users, high performance, continuous improvement, and bold execution at global scale.
stage: 全球 Top 10 · 成熟国际化平台
location: 吉隆坡 / 阿布扎比 / 香港
locationEn: Kuala Lumpur / Abu Dhabi / Hong Kong

name: AI 消费智能与营销 Agent 平台
nameEn: AI Consumer Intelligence & Marketing Agent Platform
description: 一家面向欧美市场的 AI Marketing 公司，依托其在欧洲电商领域长期积累的大规模自有销售数据，与持续运行的 AI 商业实验共同训练消费垂直模型，提升对消费者需求、内容、交易与市场趋势的理解和预测能力，并以模型与真实商业数据双轮驱动，为 C 端用户和 B 端品牌提供更智能、精准的决策支持。其关联内容与达人业务自 2022 年起深耕欧洲电商，已签约 2,000 余名欧洲本土创作者，沉淀 8,000 余名合作达人资源，并服务超过 900 个品牌，处于欧洲电商内容营销头部阵营。公司当前估值约人民币 10 亿元，已在欧美开展业务，并计划在中国深圳同步设立主体，建设全球化 AI 产品与研发团队。
descriptionEn: An AI marketing company serving European and North American markets. It combines large-scale proprietary European commerce and sales data with continuous AI-driven business experiments to train vertical consumer-intelligence models, improving the understanding and prediction of demand, content performance, transactions, and market trends. This model-and-data flywheel supports smarter decisions for both consumers and brands. Its affiliated creator-commerce operation has worked across European e-commerce since 2022, with more than 2,000 contracted local creators, a network of over 8,000 creators, and more than 900 brand clients, placing it among the leading commerce-focused creator organizations in Europe. The company is valued at approximately RMB 1 billion, operates across Western markets, and is preparing a Shenzhen entity to build a global AI product and engineering organization.
stage: 估值约人民币 10 亿元
location: 欧美 / 深圳（主体筹备中）
locationEn: Europe & North America / Shenzhen entity in formation

name: 全球 AI 智能硬件与生产力平台
nameEn: Global AI Smart Hardware & Productivity Platform
description: 一家总部位于旧金山、面向全球专业人士的 AI 智能硬件与生产力公司，通过软硬件结合的方式捕捉、结构化并沉淀现实世界对话中的信息，帮助用户提升思考、决策与执行效率。产品自 2023 年推出以来已服务超过 200 万名全球用户。公司坚持自举发展并已实现盈利，在约三年内达到约 2.5 亿美元收入运行率，商业化与全球扩张速度突出。平台已建立 ISO 27001、ISO 27701、SOC 2、GDPR、EN 18031 与 HIPAA 等安全、隐私及合规体系。美国团队目前约 8 人，强调本地产品闭环，同时与国内工程及供应链团队协作推进量产，正在定义下一代人机智能交互入口。
descriptionEn: A San Francisco-based AI smart-hardware and productivity company serving professionals worldwide. Its integrated hardware-and-software products capture, structure, and compound intelligence from real-world conversations to help users think better, decide faster, and execute with clarity. Since launching in 2023, the products have been adopted by more than two million users globally. The bootstrapped and profitable company reached an approximately US$250 million revenue run rate in about three years and is expanding rapidly across global markets. It has established comprehensive security and privacy programs spanning ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2, GDPR, EN 18031, and HIPAA. The US team currently has approximately eight members and owns a strong local product loop while partnering with engineering and supply-chain teams in China for mass production, with the ambition to define the next generation of human-AI interfaces.
stage: 自举盈利 · 约 2.5 亿美元收入运行率
stageEn: Bootstrapped & Profitable · Approx. US$250M Revenue Run Rate

name: 超一线互联网大厂 AI 资源与采购团队
nameEn: Top-Tier Internet Company · AI Resources & Procurement Team
description: 一家超一线互联网大厂内部的 AI 资源与采购团队，负责连接大模型训练、AI 应用研发与外部供应市场。团队统一引入模型 API、MaaS 服务、企业账号与调用额度，并采购标准化数据集和定制化训练语料；同时以大模型、Agent、知识库和工作流自动化改造传统采购流程。业务横跨产品、算法、工程、采购、数据治理、法务合规与财务，核心目标是在安全合规的前提下，提高 AI 资源供给效率、交付质量和成本透明度，为大规模 AI 业务提供可持续的基础设施支持。
descriptionEn: An AI resources and procurement team within a top-tier internet company, connecting model training and AI application teams with external suppliers. The team sources model APIs, MaaS services, enterprise accounts, and usage credits; procures standardized datasets and customized training corpora; and modernizes procurement through LLMs, agents, knowledge systems, and workflow automation. Its cross-functional remit spans Product, AI, Engineering, Procurement, Data Governance, Legal, Compliance, and Finance, with the goal of providing scalable, reliable, cost-transparent, and compliant AI resource infrastructure.
stage: 超一线互联网大厂 · AI 基础设施核心团队
stageEn: Top-Tier Internet Company · Core AI Infrastructure Team

name: 全球 AI 视觉叙事创作平台
description: 一家高速增长的全球 AI 视觉叙事创作平台，由前头部科技公司创业者创立，面向全球创作者、内容团队与专业用户，提供覆盖图像、视频、角色、音频和完整故事生产的一体化创作体验。平台已从早期 AI 图像发现与生成工具，持续演进为支持角色一致性、视觉编辑、视频生成与故事创作的完整产品矩阵。2025 年公司收入增长约 7 倍，ARR 从约 1,050 万美元增长至超过 7,000 万美元，月活用户超过 800 万，并完成由知名美元基金领投的 3,500 万美元 A 轮融资。团队保持精干、高速和产品驱动，已经验证全球用户需求与订阅商业模式，现阶段的核心任务是把强产品势能进一步升级为全球品牌、创作者生态和可持续增长体系。
descriptionEn: A fast-growing global AI visual-storytelling platform founded by former leaders from a top technology company. It serves creators, content teams, and professionals with an integrated experience spanning image, video, characters, audio, and end-to-end story creation. The product has evolved from an early AI-image discovery and generation tool into a broader creative suite supporting character consistency, visual editing, video generation, and storytelling workflows. In 2025, revenue grew approximately sevenfold, ARR expanded from about US$10.5 million to more than US$70 million, monthly active users surpassed eight million, and the company raised a US$35 million Series A led by a prominent US venture firm. The lean, product-driven team has already validated global demand and subscription monetization; its next chapter is to turn strong product momentum into an enduring global brand, creator ecosystem, and scalable growth engine.
stage: A 轮 · 3,500 万美元融资 · ARR 超 7,000 万美元
stageEn: Series A · US$35M Raised · US$70M+ ARR

name: 新一代 AGI 模型与 Agent 平台
description: 一家新成立的中国新一代 AGI 模型公司，面向率先采用人工智能的知识工作者，探索研究、创作、决策、协作与执行等高价值场景中的数量级效率提升。团队已聚集高密度的模型研究、工程与产品人才，并拥有支撑前沿探索的算力和研发资源。公司并非只在基础模型之上构建简单应用，而是推动模型能力、Agent Harness 与真实用户任务共同演进，致力于定义前沿模型进入复杂工作流的最佳接口。现阶段处于核心产品与品牌从 0 到 1 的关键时期，早期成员能够直接参与技术路线、产品体验、开发者生态和全球传播体系的建设。
descriptionEn: A newly established next-generation AGI model company in China, focused on delivering order-of-magnitude productivity gains for pioneering knowledge workers across research, creation, decision-making, collaboration, and execution. The team brings together high-density model research, engineering, and product talent with the compute and resources required for frontier development. Rather than building a thin application layer, it is co-evolving model capabilities, Agent Harness infrastructure, and real-world user tasks to define the best interface between frontier intelligence and complex workflows. The company is at a pivotal zero-to-one stage across product, developer ecosystem, and brand, giving early team members meaningful influence over technology, experience, and global adoption.
stage: 早期核心团队 · 模型与 Agent 协同研发
location: 北京 / 深圳 / 上海

name: 前沿密态计算与 AI 数据安全平台
description: 一家由国内顶尖高校计算机团队孵化的前沿 AI 数据安全公司，长期专注高性能密态计算，致力于解决 AI 训练、推理与数据协作中的隐私和安全难题。团队将传统密态计算的高额性能损耗压缩至个位数倍，在无需依赖硬件可信执行环境的情况下，同时兼顾理论安全性、工程效率与通用性，并兼容 PyTorch、TensorFlow 等主流 AI 框架。公司曾获得国家级创新创业赛事冠军，并获多家国家级媒体报道；成立半年内完成数千万元人民币天使轮融资，估值达到数亿元人民币。团队由国内外顶尖高校 AI 实验室专家及头部互联网公司人才组成，处于技术产品化和全球市场从 0 到 1 的关键阶段，早期成员拥有较高决策空间、股权激励和直接参与行业基础设施建设的机会。
descriptionEn: A frontier AI data-security company incubated by a computer science team from a leading Chinese university. It develops high-performance confidential computing for privacy-preserving AI training, inference, and data collaboration. The team has reduced the traditionally severe performance overhead of encrypted computation to a single-digit multiple without relying on hardware trusted execution environments, while preserving strong security, engineering efficiency, broad applicability, and compatibility with mainstream frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow. The company has won a national innovation competition and received coverage from major national media. Within six months of formation, it completed an angel round worth tens of millions of RMB at a valuation of several hundred million RMB. Its team combines AI-lab experts from leading universities with experienced talent from major technology companies and is now moving from technical breakthrough to productization and global market development.
stage: 天使轮 · 数千万元融资 · 数亿元估值
stageEn: Angel Stage · Tens of Millions RMB Raised · Several-Hundred-Million RMB Valuation

name: 全球头部数字金融与交易基础设施平台
nameEn: Leading Global Digital Finance & Trading Infrastructure Platform
description: 一家全球领先的数字金融与交易基础设施平台，面向全球个人高净值用户、专业交易者与机构客户，提供数字资产交易、支付、资产管理、机构服务和 Web3 基础能力。平台拥有大规模国际用户和复杂金融系统的长期运营经验，产品团队直接参与 VIP 与机构服务、金融产品增长、支付及法币通道等核心业务。团队分布于亚太及多个国际市场，强调中英文双语协作、快速迭代、强结果导向与面向全球用户的产品判断。当前多个负责人岗位直接汇报产品一号位，能够在成熟业务规模之上主导关键产品体系的下一阶段升级。
descriptionEn: A leading global digital-finance and trading-infrastructure platform serving high-net-worth individuals, active traders, and institutional clients worldwide. Its ecosystem spans digital-asset trading, payments, wealth products, institutional services, and Web3 infrastructure. The platform brings deep experience operating large-scale international user businesses and complex financial systems, while its product organization owns mission-critical areas including VIP and institutional experiences, financial-product growth, payments, and fiat access. Teams operate across APAC and global markets with bilingual collaboration, rapid iteration, strong accountability, and international product judgment. Several leadership roles report directly to the head of Product and offer the opportunity to shape the next stage of core platform capabilities at meaningful scale.
stage: 全球头部平台 · 成熟规模化业务
stageEn: Leading Global Platform · Mature Business at Scale
location: 亚太地区 / 香港 / 新加坡

name: 全球 Physical AI 人类体验数据平台
nameEn: Global Physical AI Human Experience Data Platform
description: 一家总部位于新加坡、近期增长迅速的 Physical AI 与具身智能数据基础设施公司。团队通过自研可穿戴采集硬件与软件系统，记录真实世界中的第一视角视频、深度、动作与音频，并将人类完成复杂物理任务的过程转化为可供机器人、世界模型和空间智能系统训练的大规模多模态数据。公司成立于 2025 年，2026 年 7 月完成约 2,200 万美元 Pre-A 轮融资，累计融资约 3,000 万美元；其千万级真实人类物体交互公开数据集发布后短期内下载量突破 200 万次，验证了 Physical AI 对规模化真实世界数据的强需求。核心团队拥有清华、Meta、Google 与 UC Berkeley 等背景，目前约 60 名全职员工及实习生分布于新加坡、中国、马来西亚和美国，正持续扩大数据采集网络、设备量产和新加坡及美国交付能力。
descriptionEn: A fast-growing Singapore-headquartered Physical AI and embodied-intelligence data infrastructure company. Its proprietary wearable capture hardware and software record first-person video, depth, motion, and audio from real-world tasks, converting human physical experience into large-scale multimodal training data for robotics, world models, and spatial-intelligence systems. Founded in 2025, the company completed an approximately US$22 million pre-Series A round in July 2026, bringing total funding to about US$30 million. Its public dataset covering ten million real human-object interactions surpassed two million downloads shortly after release, demonstrating strong demand for scalable real-world Physical AI data. The core team brings experience from Tsinghua, Meta, Google, and UC Berkeley, with approximately 60 employees and interns across Singapore, China, Malaysia, and the United States. The company is now expanding its data-collection network, device production, and delivery capacity in Singapore and the US.
stage: Pre-A · 新融资约 2,200 万美元 · 累计约 3,000 万美元
stageEn: Pre-Series A · Approx. US$22M New Round · US$30M Total Funding
location: 新加坡 / 中国 / 马来西亚 / 美国

name: 跨境 VLA 与 Physical AI 基础模型平台
nameEn: Cross-Border VLA & Physical AI Foundation Platform
description: 一家处于创始阶段的跨境 AI 公司，围绕计算机视觉、机器学习、多模态模型、垂直基础模型与大规模真实世界数据系统构建下一代智能基础设施。团队的短期重点并非直接制造机器人本体，而是先建立具有差异化和可防御性的模型、数据、评测与 AI 平台能力，并逐步延伸至 Vision-Language-Action、具身智能与 Physical AI。创始团队在技术创业、商业化、运营、投资和中美资源协同方面经验互补，能够提供差异化真实世界数据资源及硅谷与上海双地平台。公司正从零搭建核心技术班底，早期成员将直接参与技术路线、产品定位、组织建设、合作生态与融资叙事的定义。
descriptionEn: An early-stage cross-border AI company building next-generation intelligence infrastructure across computer vision, machine learning, multimodal systems, vertical foundation models, and large-scale real-world data. Rather than beginning with robot hardware, the company is first establishing differentiated and defensible model, data, evaluation, and AI-platform capabilities, with a long-term roadmap toward Vision-Language-Action, embodied intelligence, and Physical AI. The founding team combines experience in technology entrepreneurship, commercialization, operations, investment, and US-China ecosystem development, with access to differentiated real-world data resources and a dual presence across Silicon Valley and Shanghai. The company is now assembling its founding technical team, giving early leaders meaningful influence over technology, product, organization, partnerships, and fundraising narrative.
stage: 创始阶段 · 硅谷与上海跨境团队
stageEn: Founding Stage · Silicon Valley and Shanghai

name: 交互式世界模型与 Physical AI 平台
nameEn: Interactive World Models & Physical AI Platform
description: 一家总部位于北美、处于早期阶段的 AI 公司，正在构建面向 Physical AI 的交互式世界基础模型。团队以世界模型、多模态生成、仿真与交互学习为核心，服务自动驾驶与机器人系统的闭环训练、模拟和评测，并在模型、数据、训练基础设施与图形仿真之间形成完整技术链路。公司拥有充足的算力资源和数据积累，技术路线强调真实任务价值、规模化训练效率与可复现的系统能力。研发协作覆盖北美、新加坡、苏黎世及中国远程，早期成员能够深度参与核心模型、数据和基础设施能力的从零建设。
descriptionEn: An early-stage AI company headquartered in North America, building interactive world foundation models for Physical AI. Its work spans world models, multimodal generation, simulation, and interactive learning for closed-loop training, simulation, and evaluation of autonomous systems and robotics. The technical stack connects models, data, large-scale training infrastructure, and graphics simulation into an integrated platform. With substantial compute capacity and data resources, the team focuses on real task value, scalable training efficiency, and reproducible systems. R&D collaboration spans North America, Singapore, Zurich, and remote contributors in China, giving early technical hires significant ownership across core model, data, and infrastructure capabilities.
stage: 早期阶段 · 全球研发协作
location: 北美 / 新加坡 / 苏黎世 / 中国远程
locationEn: North America / Singapore / Zurich / China Remote

name: 全球 AI 体育影像智能硬件公司
nameEn: Global AI Sports Imaging Hardware Company
description: 一家处于 B 轮阶段的全球化 AI 智能硬件公司，聚焦智能影像与体育科技，为全球消费者打造兼具技术创新与真实使用价值的产品。公司具备健康的自我造血能力和稳健现金流，业务连续多年保持高速增长；国内已形成数百人规模的产品、研发与商业化组织，并在美国硅谷设有创新实验团队，持续推进北美市场和前沿产品探索。核心管理与技术团队拥有国内顶尖高校、海外科研及国际头部科技企业背景，在软件、算法、影像、通信和全球化业务方面积累深厚。团队文化开放、平等、尊重专业判断，适合既理解成熟国际品牌方法、又愿意参与高速成长业务的管理者。
descriptionEn: A Series B global AI smart-hardware company focused on intelligent imaging and sports technology, building differentiated consumer products for international markets. The business combines healthy self-generated cash flow with sustained high growth. Its China organization spans product, engineering, and commercialization at meaningful scale, while a Silicon Valley innovation team explores frontier products and the North American market. The leadership and technical organization brings experience from top universities, overseas research environments, and leading international technology companies across software, algorithms, imaging, communications, and global business. The culture is open, collaborative, and professionally driven, offering an attractive environment for leaders who combine global-brand discipline with an entrepreneurial operating mindset.
stage: B轮 · 具备稳定造血能力

name: 具身智能真实场景数据基础设施平台
nameEn: Embodied AI Real-World Data Infrastructure Platform
description: 一家面向具身智能与 Physical AI 的真实场景数据基础设施公司，致力于解决机器人和智能系统从 Demo 走向规模化落地时面临的高质量交互数据瓶颈。平台围绕真实场景建立覆盖采集、标注、数据配比、模型评测与部署支持的端到端能力，为产业客户提供标准化、可复用、可规模扩展的数据产品与服务，并形成从真实任务到数据底座、模型迭代和本体落地的价值闭环。公司由具备大型产业平台、自动驾驶、AI 数据工程与具身智能创业经验的团队联合发起，兼具长期数据体系建设能力、产业资源与从 0 到 1 的产品化经验，目标是成为连接场景方、模型团队与机器人本体的重要中立基础设施。
descriptionEn: A real-world data infrastructure company serving Embodied AI and Physical AI. The platform addresses the shortage of high-quality interaction data that limits robotics and intelligent systems as they move from demos to scalable deployment. Its end-to-end capabilities span real-world data collection, annotation, data-mixture design, model evaluation, and deployment support, delivering standardized, reusable, and scalable data products for industrial customers. The company was initiated by operators and technical leaders with broad experience across large-scale industry platforms, autonomous systems, AI data engineering, and embodied-intelligence ventures, combining long-term data-system expertise, industrial resources, and zero-to-one product-building capability.
stage: 早期阶段 · 产业与技术团队联合发起
stageEn: Early Stage · Industry and Technology Team Collaboration
